name: arc-fill-between-markers
description: Use when aligned sparse markers bracket intervals to fill.
---

# Fill intervals between aligned markers

Use when an ARC demonstration shows sparse markers on a uniform background and adds a third color in spaces between aligned marks.

1. Identify the uniform background, marker color, and fill color from the examples. Keep all markers and all background cells outside qualifying intervals unchanged.
2. For each row, find the first and last marker. Replace only background cells strictly between them with the fill color. Do not extend past either endpoint.
3. Repeat for each column: find its first and last marker and fill only background cells strictly between those endpoints.
4. Preserve marker pixels even if a row/column interval crosses them. Overlapping row and column fills simply remain fill color.
5. Validate dimensions and allowed colors. Avoid extending rays to grid boundaries unless demonstrations explicitly show that behavior.

A key distinction: fill the intervals bracketed by markers, not every background cell, not just between adjacent marker pairs, and not unbounded rays. Rows/columns with a single marker contribute no interval in that direction.", "path": "arc/arc-fill-between-markers/SKILL.md", "skill_dir": "/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-hermesagentlearner-1790682203/attempts/f5d0129c74114c3ebf8aa1c75e810ecf/system/state/hermes/skills/arc/arc-fill-between-markers", "org_provenance": null, "linked_files": null, "usage_hint": null, "required_environment_variables": [], "required_commands": [], "missing_required_environment_variables": [], "missing_credential_files": [], "missing_required_commands": [], "setup_needed": false, "setup_skipped": false, "readiness_status": "available", "_source_path": "/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-hermesagentlearner-1790682203/attempts/f5d0129c74114c3ebf8aa1c75e810ecf/system/state/hermes/skills/arc/arc-fill-between-markers/SKILL.md"}
